articles.title: El Comité de Disciplina anuncia las sanciones, pero resolverá la de Owono "próximamente"
articles.standfirst: "Las cuestiones derivadas del acta del encuentro CD Tenerife - FC Andorra serán resueltas próximamente", se lee en la resolución
articles.summary: "Las cuestiones derivadas del acta del encuentro CD Tenerife - FC Andorra serán resueltas próximamente", se lee en la resolución
articles.body: El Comité de Disciplina de la RFEF, que esta tarde ha anunciado las sanciones correspondientes a la jornada 12 de LaLiga Hypermotion, aún no ha decidido que medida tomará con Jesús Owono, portero del Andorra, que vio la cartulina roja tras la acción que acabó con el fatal desenlace del fallecimiento de Jesús de Miguel. El Juez Único de Competición dio este miércoles por concluido el partido Tenerife-Andorra con el resultado reflejado en el acta arbitral (2-2) en el momento de su suspensión, motivo por el cual no se conocerá la sanción a Owono este jueves, ya que los clubes deben disponer de un plazo para presentar las alegaciones. "Dado que el partido fue concluido en el día de ayer por resolución del Juez de Competiciones para las competiciones profesionales, las cuestiones derivadas del acta del encuentro CD Tenerife - FC Andorra serán resueltas próximamente", se lee en la resolución del Comité de Disciplina, que aplaza su decisión sin desvelar cuándo será oficial. En el acta del encuentro, el colegiado Manuel Ángel Pérez Hernández recogió que el meta fue expulsado "por impactar bruscamente con su pierna en alto sobre un adversario con uso de fuerza excesiva cuando el balón estaba en disputa. El jugador fue atendido sobre el terreno de juego, abandonando posteriormente el campo en camilla". En su resolución, el Juez Único de Competición dio por concluido el encuentro, ya que "las circunstancias que concurren en el presente supuesto revisten un carácter absolutamente excepcional, por cuanto la suspensión del encuentro se produjo a consecuencia del grave incidente sufrido por un futbolista durante su transcurso, que, desgraciadamente, desembocó en su posterior fallecimiento. Ante una situación de esta naturaleza, este órgano competicional considera que la decisión sobre la eventual reanudación o conclusión del encuentro debe adoptarse atendiendo, de manera primordial, a razones de humanidad, sensibilidad y respeto hacia la memoria del futbolista fallecido, su familia, sus compañeros y todas las personas afectadas por tan dolorosa pérdida. Desde esta perspectiva [...] se estima que lo más respetuoso con las extraordinarias y dolorosas circunstancias de este caso es dar por concluido el encuentro".

articles.title: Joel Klatt rips CFP committee's Ohio State rationale 'you didn't watch'
articles.summary: Joel Klatt disputes the CFP committee's critique of Ohio State's defensive line after the team's recent ranking.
articles.body:
FOX Sports commentator Joel Klatt largely disagreed with the College Football Playoff selection committee's claims about Ohio State's defensive play, one of the factors that weighed into Ohio State landing one slot outside the CFP bracket .

While speaking on ESPN, selection committee chair Hunter Yurachek mentioned that some of the coaches in the selection room expressed concern for the Buckeyes' defensive front throughout the season.

"Let me tell you what was not the largest problem for Ohio State was their defensive line," Klatt said on "The Joel Klatt Show" Nov. 4. "In fact, if you have watched Ohio State, you would know that their defense largely has been playing better because of their defensive line. I hope that [Yurachek] just misspoke in that moment. Because that was just red flags all over there."

Klatt pointed to the issues with Ohio State's offensive line as a larger concern to the overall quality of the Buckeyes' play.

"I'd probably nod along if you told me that the offensive line and their penalty issues, and their lack of physicality and short-yardage inside the 1-yard line," he said. "I'd nod along with you. But if you tell me it's the defensive line's fault that they're ranked No. 12, you didn't watch."

OSU Buckeyes face USC Trojans in Big Ten football. See the photos

Ohio State committed 11 penalties for a loss of 75 yards against USC. The offensive line committed four penalties for a loss of 17 yards: a false start from Austin Siereveld and holding infractions by Gabe VanSickle, Phillip Daniels and Carson Hinzman. The Buckeyes also struggled in pass protection, allowing 18 pressures to quarterback Luke Fahey, according to Pro Football Focus.

Ohio State's defense struggled on two explosive plays: a 69-yard touchdown reception and a 70-yard reception that set USC up at the 3-yard line. Before the game, the Buckeyes were one of two FBS defenses that had not allowed a play over 40 yards.

Ohio State also played without standout nickel back Jay Timmons , who was out with an injury.

"This is very apparent that this is about Luke Fahey and Julian Sayin's injury, and nothing else," Klatt said.

articles.title: Texas vs. Missouri prediction, odds, pick for SEC clash in Week 10
articles.summary: The No. 7 Texas Longhorns visit the No. 18 Missouri Tigers on Saturday, November 7, in an SEC game with College Football Playoff stakes. Both teams are 6-2 a...
articles.body:
The No. 7 Texas Longhorns visit the No. 18 Missouri Tigers on Saturday, November 7, in an SEC game with College Football Playoff stakes. Both teams are 6-2 and have two losses. Kickoff at Memorial Stadium in Columbia is scheduled for noon ET on ESPN.

The matchup puts Arch Manning and a banged-up Texas roster against a Missouri team that is unbeaten at home. Texas is the slim favorite, but injuries, a reshuffled offensive line and Missouri's home record make this closer than the spread suggests.

Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial)

Texas has the longer list. Left tackle Trevor Goosby is out for the season with a torn patellar tendon, and running back Hollywood Smothers is unlikely to play. Receivers Ryan Wingo and Cam Coleman are dealing with shoulder injuries, and edge rusher Colin Simmons is still recovering from an ankle injury.

Cornerback Graceson Littleton could miss the rest of the regular season, and Kade Phillips has been reported with a groin injury. Coach Steve Sarkisian refuses to discuss injuries and has said his team will be "undermanned" in Columbia. These are early-week reports, not final game designations.

Missouri's first SEC availability report of the week added no new names.

Texas is 3-5 against the spread this season, including 3-4 as a favorite of 2.5 points or more. Four of its eight games have gone over the total.

Manning has thrown for 1,727 yards and 15 touchdowns while completing 64.8% of his passes. He averaged more than 11 yards per completion in his most recent game, which was one of his most efficient passing performances of the season.

With Smothers out, Raleek Brown is the lead back with 452 yards and five touchdowns. The bigger problem is protection. Texas has allowed 20 sacks in five SEC games, and its offensive line has two tackles in new positions, Andre Cojoe at right tackle and Melvin Siani at left.

On the other side, Texas leads the nation in yards per play allowed.

Missouri is 4-4 against the spread, with three of its eight games going over. It is 1-2 against the spread as an underdog of 2.5 points or more.

Coach Eli Drinkwitz is 11-4 against the spread as a home underdog, and Missouri is 226-164-11 against the spread in comparable home games between ranked teams. Sarkisian is 22-13 against the spread when fading him on the road, per Slim Sports.

Quarterback Austin Simmons has made big throws, including in the Week 9 win over Arkansas. Running back Jamal Roberts ran over Florida, and Ahmad Hardy is slowly returning. Missouri's defense has not allowed a quarterback to complete more than 60% of his passes since Florida's Aaron Philo.

The weak spot is the pass rush. Missouri has just 11 sacks in league play, 12th in the SEC. But Missouri also allows 260.4 passing yards per game in conference play, so Manning could find space if his line holds.

Texas must protect Manning. A reshuffled line against a Missouri front that is not a strong pass-rushing unit gives the Longhorns a chance, but an early sack or two could force Texas into long-yardage situations.

Missouri needs to run the ball and keep the game low-scoring. Roberts and Hardy give the Tigers a way to control the clock and keep Texas' defense on the field.

Colin Simmons' return would be a major boost for Texas. Covers expects him to play. Without him, Missouri's offense should have an easier time moving the ball.

This feels like a trap game for Texas, and the numbers back that up. Missouri is unbeaten at home and Texas is thin at several key positions.

Texas' defense should keep it in the game, and the Longhorns could grind out a narrow win. But with that offensive line, taking the points is the better value.

articles.title: Jack Grealish to miss Coventry clash as David Moyes keeps tight-lipped over Everton future after disciplinary exile
articles.summary: Jack Grealish’s difficult second spell at Everton has taken another frustrating turn as manager David Moyes confirmed the midfielder will not feature in Frid...
articles.body:
Jack Grealish's difficult second spell at Everton has taken another frustrating turn as manager David Moyes confirmed the midfielder will not feature in Friday's Premier League meeting with Coventry City. The 31-year-old remains on the sidelines following a recent disciplinary issue that has seen him excluded from the first-team setup.

Everton midfielder Grealish is set to extend his spell on the sidelines as the Toffees prepare for their upcoming clash with Coventry City. The 31-year-old, currently on loan from Manchester City, has already missed the club's last two fixtures against Newcastle in both the Premier League and Carabao Cup following a 'breach of club discipline' .

Moyes addressed the situation during his pre-match press conference on Thursday, confirming that the creative midfielder is not yet ready to return to the fold. "No, Jack is not available," Moyes stated firmly. Despite the tension surrounding the situation, the veteran coach suggested that a reconciliation could be on the horizon. "I wouldn't give you the plan but we will be working with Jack again soon."

The club had previously attributed his absence on Monday to a lack of match fitness, though Moyes had declined to offer a detailed comment at that specific time.

Uncertainty during the international break

With the domestic schedule set to pause for the upcoming international break, many observers believe this period could provide the necessary breathing room for both parties to resolve their differences. When questioned on whether the gap in fixtures would allow for a definitive resolution to the disciplinary matter, Moyes remained non-committal about the timeline for a potential return. "We just need to wait and see how things go," the Everton boss added.

The lack of a clear return date suggests that Grealish - a decorated winner of three Premier League titles, a Champions League, an FA Cup, a UEFA Super Cup, and a Club World Cup - must still prove his commitment to the coaching staff before he is integrated back into the matchday squad.

Grealish's current predicament is a far cry from his status as a key figure in Manchester City's historic Treble-winning campaign during the 2022-23 season. With his contract set to expire at the end of the campaign, the midfielder now faces an uncertain future at club level.

His first loan spell at Goodison Park showed flashes of his undeniable quality, as he netted twice in 22 appearances, but that period was ultimately hampered by a significant injury.

On the pitch, Grealish has struggled to make an impact during his second loan spell with Everton, failing to score in his six appearances across all competitions this season. His absence comes at a crucial juncture for the Toffees, who currently sit seventh in the Premier League table on 13 points, just three points adrift of fourth-placed Chelsea.

articles.title: El fútbol español se unirá en homenaje a Jesús de Miguel: se juega la jornada y se parará en el minuto 9
articles.standfirst: Los partidos recordarán al jugador del Tenerife fallecido el pasado martes
articles.summary: Los partidos recordarán al jugador del Tenerife fallecido el pasado martes
articles.body: La Real Federación Española de Fútbol, LALIGA y Liga F rendirán homenaje a Jesús de Miguel, jugador del Tenerife fallecido este martes, durante la próxima jornada, que se disputa del 6 al 9 de noviembre. Las tres instituciones, junto a clubes y futbolistas, han acordado un conjunto de acciones para que todo el fútbol español le recuerde de forma unida en cada estadio, bajo el lema 'Siempre en nuestro recuerdo'. Habrá un homenaje en todos los estadios. Los futbolistas titulares de ambos equipos saldrán al terreno de juego entremezclados y vistiendo una camiseta especial con el dorsal 9 y el lema 'Siempre en nuestro recuerdo'. Junto a los árbitros, formarán un semicírculo abrazados en torno al punto del campo en el que se produjo la jugada del pasado lunes. Allí, los capitanes, que saldrán en último lugar, depositarán una ofrenda floral en su memoria. A continuación se guardará un minuto de silencio, durante el cual los videomarcadores y los soportes de los estadios mostrarán una imagen de Jesús de Miguel, seguido de un aplauso de jugadores y aficionados. El recuerdo continuará con el partido ya en juego. En la primera interrupción a partir del minuto 9, en referencia a su dorsal, el árbitro detendrá el encuentro y los videomarcadores proyectarán un vídeo en homenaje al jugador. Tras el aplauso de los futbolistas desde sus posiciones, se reanudará el juego. El minuto de silencio se extenderá además a todas las competiciones de ámbito nacional organizadas por la RFEF y Liga F que se disputen durante esos días, para que el homenaje alcance a todos los niveles del fútbol español. Además, el sábado 7 de noviembre, a las 18:00 horas (hora canaria; 19:00 horas en la península), el CD Tenerife celebrará en el Estadio Heliodoro Rodríguez López un solemne homenaje en recuerdo del jugador, abierto a toda su afición. El acto podrá seguirse en directo a través del canal LaLiga Hypermotion y del canal oficial de YouTube de LaLiga, además de en los canales de la RFEF. Esta iniciativa, trasladada a clubes, jugadores y jugadoras, pretende ser un reconocimiento y sentido homenaje de este deporte en todos los estadios, como la mejor manera de honrar la memoria del jugador fallecido. Entendiendo y respetando las distintas sensibilidades expresadas en estos momentos de dolor, la voluntad es que toda la familia del fútbol profesional pueda recordar al jugador con el respeto, la dignidad y el reconocimiento que merece. "La RFEF, LaLiga y Liga F reiteran sus más sinceras condolencias a la familia y seres queridos de Jesús de Miguel, a sus compañeros y a toda la familia del CD Tenerife, a quienes acompañan en estos difíciles momentos", se lee en el comunicado. Por otra parte, quedan suspendidos tres encuentros de la jornada de LaLiga Hypermotion: Castellón–Eibar, Granada–Tenerife y Andorra–Mallorca. Por su parte, Liga F Moeve aplazará el partido entre el Costa Adeje Tenerife y el Deportivo Alavés. Las nuevas fechas se comunicarán próximamente.
